articles.body: The elephant is currently in an illegal position in your photo. If you had to move it to Bombay, or if it was already in Bombay when the company deployed there, it should have been placed fully within the region to represent an upcoming rebellion. So the crisis being resolved now is a +0 rebellion against the company, which you luckily win by default, even with no armies in Bombay.

articles.body:
[q="mugurelioan"]The elephant arrived there after I resolved this crisis 
[imageid=7134989 medium]
With this map situation
[imageid=7134992 medium][/q]
So Maratha Rebels against Dehli (successfully, I presume, because the picture in the OP has the flag in Maratha removed).  The next step is to move the elephant to Mysore (because it's on top of the stack).  Because Mysore is sovereign, it will attack outward toward the circle border (Bombay).  

It looks like you simply had the elephant backwards.  You put it on the correct border, but Mysore is the attacker (it's an invasion by Mysore, and the Company will be the defender because they control Bombay).

There's a great flowchart which helps me process these: https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/245812/crisis-event-elephants-march-flowchart

articles.body:
[q="Ditocoaf"]That all sounds correct to me.

The elephant will now go to Bengal, since that's the top of your next card. Bengal will attack whichever region is across its Triangle border.[/q]
Incorrect.  After a successful Invasion the newly minted empire will attempt to continue to conquer new areas (Imperial Ambitions).  

[q]Place elephant in capital’s region (Imperial Ambitions)
Point it across the border with the symbol that matches the one on the crisis event card.
If that region is already dominated, rotate elephant to next clockwise region border.
If all are dominated, leave elephant on border symbol matching event card, but point inward
toward capital.[/q]

In this case, the Triangle showing after the successful invasion of Bombay means that the new Empire of Mysore will try to continue it's conquest across the triangle border, which is Hyderabad.  That's the next Crisis (Elephant on border between Mysore and Hyderabad, pointed at Hyderabad).
